description.value:
Apply only to a summoned Flash Mob Hype Thrall. It lasts 1 minute from creation, then disappears. This marker grants no attacks, actions, bonuses, or replenishing resources.

Runtime supplies Blaster's actor/token origin and PF2e Summons Assistant summoner linkage. The helper deletes the token when PF2e removes the expired marker, provided its necromancer.thrall.auto-expire setting is enabled (default true). The module also removes summons identified by its owner and creation-nonce flags after 60 world-time seconds, even if helper auto-expire or PF2e automatic effect removal is disabled. Without runtime, the GM tracks and removes expired thralls manually. Removing this marker early can invoke the helper's deletion handler; do not drag it onto Blaster.
